prior_importants.description: The step 8 quoting fix covers only `pup plan add`. Every comment the skill posts (needs-info, brief, design note, rejection, close) quotes issue text and markdown backticks, yet the skill never says how to post it. A double-quoted `--body "..."` or `gh issue close --comment "..."` runs backticks and `$(...)` from the issue on the operator's machine.

process_issues.description: The checkout and the reviewers were at 0838adee, but the PR head moved to 8f9578b8 during the review. I checked the new head with `gh pr diff 438`. It adds a `--body-file` rule to triage SKILL.md (L17), which resolves the prior important. It names `OWNER`/`MEMBER`/`COLLABORATOR` in step 1, which resolves the prior nit. It adds an author check to `.claude/skills/to-tickets/SKILL.md`. No reviewer reviewed the 0838adee..8f9578b8 delta, so the next incremental round should run from 0838adee.

I skipped correctness, context, simplicity, guards, workflow-safety, maintainability and spec. The delta is markdown skill prose only: it has no code logic, no workflow change, no new file or construct, and no linked issue.
